DEDICATED_MAPPING.source_basis: Initial dedicated swath survey after regional SVP application; cruise report states survey intended to fill bathymetric gaps / locate ridge axis / provide TOBI roadmap and reports generally good data quality except outer 5-10 beams.

LATER_OPERATIONAL_TOBI_TRANSIT.source_basis: Later operational acquisition during TOBI-era transits/redeployments; Appendix D includes line 31 transit to TOBI 02 re-deployment and line 32 TOBI survey 02.

important_epistemic_note: Regime labels are source-derived from cruise documentation. They do NOT predeclare that either product must pass or fail. Both products must be tested and reported.

comparison.geometry_thinning: one 2005 sounding per 100m candidate-centered square cell chosen nearest cell center without using depth
comparison.depth_estimator: median good-beam depth within 100m of each retained 2005 support coordinate

calibration_question: Does the source-native dedicated-mapping vs later-operational product distinction produce a reproducible difference in temporal morphology fidelity on the external known-positive region?
